_meta.what: Depth-100 original 10k-panel gene capture (region_validation_d100) re-scored on the REPAIRED shared PGFam cache, old vs new, per region x mode, with the change attributed to truncated vs stale-[] repaired entries.
_meta.old: committed: gene_capture_cells.csv / gene_capture_by_region.json (2026-10-20; include + exclude_0.987) and gene_capture_*_tau0995 + gene_capture_tau_compare.json (2026-11-11; exclude_0.995). Re-derived here by an old-value pass that sets the 1,006 repaired entries back to backup_old_values and reproduces all 7 committed files byte for byte.
_meta.classes: cell class by the repaired genomes among {source} U {old-pass reps} U {new-pass reps}: truncated_only / stale_only / both / none

metric_definitions.recall_resolved: macro mean recall over OK cells (headline_macro_recall_pct_resolved/100)
metric_definitions.recall_population: macro mean recall over OK + abstained + pred_empty (recall 0 for the latter)
metric_definitions.f1_population: macro mean F1 over the population cells (F1 0 for abstained/pred_empty)
metric_definitions.f1_resolved: macro mean F1 over OK cells
metric_definitions.precision_resolved: macro mean precision over OK cells

attribution_methods.attribution_exact_additive: contribution_K = sum_{c in K} [(v_new-m_old)*in_new - (v_old-m_old)*in_old] / N_new; sums exactly to the delta; share = contribution / delta
attribution_methods.counterfactual: metric with only one class's cells taking their repaired values (others old); 'both' cells need both repairs

_meta.foreign_patric_id_note: the 2026-11-13 foreign_patric_id amendment rewrote kbase_genome_cache files 294.202 and 44139.8 only; gene capture reads only the shared PGFam cache (no RefSeq row carries a PGFam), so it does not touch this result

headline.attribution: 99-101% of the population recall/F1 change in both exclude modes comes from stale-[] cells; truncated-only cells <= 0.01 pp; include changes <= 0.03 pp (shares not meaningful)
headline.dependence_on_839_stale_repairs: with only the proven-truncated entries repaired (stale [] kept), every pooled metric stays within 0.01 pp of the committed tables (max 0.011 pp in any single region): the re-score is almost entirely the orchestrator's keep-the-839 decision

audit_crosscheck.remaining_truth_empty_note: the 38 remaining truth_empty sources are not repaired genomes; their entries are still [] and none is among the 839 stale ids, i.e. they belong to the 963 [] entries the audit judged legitimately empty (961 with PATRIC CDSs but no PGFam rows, 2 with no CDS)

other_committed_results_read_old_cache.expected_direction: Same mechanism as the d100 re-score measured here (pooled exclude_0.987: population recall +0.0086, resolved recall -0.0002; include: resolved +0.0001). Expect population recall to rise in both modes as stale-rep pred_empty cells become OK. Stale-source truth_empty cells joining the denominators move resolved recall in either direction. Here the stale exposure is smaller for sources (41 of 318 truth_empty) and 323 of 597 exclude pred_empty cells have a stale rep.

other_committed_results_read_old_cache.reads: shared PGFam cache (truth, reps, neighbours) + e3_clade_catalogue.json built from it (the catalogue excluded all 1,802 [] lists; the rebuilt one has 839 more genomes)
other_committed_results_read_old_cache.expected_direction: small; the k/n baseline gains most (stale reps were counted as gene-less in n, which pulled k/n down), so the E3-minus-k/n margin should shrink slightly; a 0.053 Brier margin with a CI half-width of about 0.002 makes a verdict flip very unlikely. About 675 more amplicons per mode become scorable. Needs a re-run against the rebuilt catalogue to state it as a number.

other_committed_results_read_old_cache.result: shared_reference k-fold benchmark (PICRUSt2 0.779 vs prFBA 0.687 macro EC F1)
other_committed_results_read_old_cache.reads: frozen copies of the pre-repair lists (a cache repair does not change them); 17 truncated panel genomes, 0 stale
other_committed_results_read_old_cache.expected_direction: negligible (about 0.2% of cells per arm). Truth EC sets grow for 17 genomes, so recall falls a little on those cells in every arm. prFBA also gains predicted ECs on about 0.3% of cells with a truncated rep. The PICRUSt2-over-prFBA ranking cannot plausibly change.

other_committed_results_read_old_cache.result: MAG validation (original, k-means and random panels)
other_committed_results_read_old_cache.reads: NOT the shared cache: frozen int-encoded panel indices extracted from it on 2026-10-08 (mag_validation/pgfam_panel.json, kmeans_panel/pgfam_panel_kmeans.json, random_panel/pgfam_panel_random.json). Not in the audit census; checked here: every repaired panel genome holds its OLD length. A cache repair does not reach these indices; they need re-extraction.
other_committed_results_read_old_cache.expected_direction: 1,220 of the 1,600 truth_empty MAG cells per regime have a stale source and would become scorable. Exclude-regime OK cells with a stale anchor (287) gain predicted families, so recall rises. Truncated sources (170 cells per regime) lower recall slightly. Net: more scorable cells and a small recall rise, but only after the panel indices are rebuilt; as committed they cannot change.
